problem_restatement.input: Checksum-complete historical depth-20 L2 exists for xyz:SP500 and xyz:SPCX, but full-window public-trade OHLC and exact mark-risk paths are absent.
problem_restatement.required_output: Determine whether a resumable trade-and-price continuation can make the two markets eligible for a distinct chronological strategy trial without redownloading L2 or changing v53.
success_criteria: Every probe book bundle is verified and skipped rather than downloaded.
Every requested trade and price bundle is complete, identity-bound, and checksum-verifiable.
Price rows disclose exact mark coverage rather than substituting oracle or midpoint values.
Probe runtime and page counts produce a bounded full-continuation estimate.
No strategy, route, asset, sizing, leverage, exit, execution, or live profile changes.

paired_short_window.limitation: This approximately 41-hour window is too short for strategy qualification and has no stored 0xArchive price bundles.

estimate_limitations: Trade projections extrapolate only the short paired window and may vary by session and listing age.
Price projection uses local MU and CL price-bundle density rather than SP500/SPCX observations.
Runtime cannot be estimated responsibly until the four-hour probe measures request pages, retries, and rate limits.

proceed_to_full_continuation_only_if: All four book tasks are checksum-verified skips.
All eight new trade/price tasks publish complete source-matched manifests.
At least one exact mark observation exists in every non-empty probe hour.
There are no normalization conflicts or unresolved participant groups.
Measured task rate and projected evidence size are operationally bounded.
defer_if: Launch history lacks public trades or exact marks for a material portion of either market.
Price evidence is oracle-only, midpoint-derived, or contains unexplained null mark paths.
Rate limiting or page counts make the continuation unbounded.
Any existing book manifest fails checksum or identity verification.
decision_rules.qualification_after_acquisition: Acquisition alone grants no economic or live authority. A distinct mechanism must still pass chronological development, frozen validation, untouched holdout, realistic fee/funding/slippage/latency replay, mark-path resolution, delay stress, session analysis, and largest-winner sensitivity.

confidence.level: high for resumable book reuse; medium for trade-volume estimate; low for full-window mark availability until probed
confidence.falsifier: Any probe book download, source-identity mismatch, incomplete bundle, absent exact mark source, or materially different page density updates this plan before a full continuation.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Execute and audit the four preregistered one-hour endpoint probes without changing v53.
